title: An agent that knows when to stop
summary: The agent loops forever and crashes when a tool fails. Add limits, loop detection and error handling.
hints: Replace while True with a for loop over max_steps. Count every call to model.next().
Keep a Counter of (tool name, args) seen so far. Use json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True) to make args comparable.
Run tools inside try/except. On error or unknown tool, add a tool message that starts with 'error:' and let the model try again.
